answer: Behaviour-fingerprint escrow unlock blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a copper bond worth twice its 30-day earnings and stands on a narrow ledge: five jobs only until its fingerprint of timing and counterparties matches its profile over 20 epochs. Peer checks, light as a zephyr, verify it; a mismatch freezes the bond 20 epochs. 100 fakes cost 100 bonds, about 200 months of earnings. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps undiluted rewards.
